title: Recurrent moderate major depressive disorder with PHQ-9
encounterNote: 34-year-old female presents for follow-up of major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate. She reports depressed mood most days, anhedonia, poor sleep, and low energy for six weeks. She denies suicidal ideation, hallucinations, and manic symptoms. The PHQ-9 score is 14. Assessment: major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate. Continue sertraline 50 mg daily and refer to psychotherapy.
